human_authorization_basis: Explicit human authorization supplied 2026-10-05 for BEPD-04A semantics-only execution; no standalone authorization artifact is created by this phase.
authorized_question: Among already-observed qualified historical sweep events, did the swept Weekly level obtain at least one strict qualifying H1 reintegration before the end of its target week?

population.denominator_if_later_authorized: all qualified EVENT_LEDGER rows, including same_week_reintegration=false

response.source_policy: use the already-qualified EVENT_LEDGER field; BEPD-04A does not recompute market outcomes
response.true_semantic: at least one strictly later qualifying H1 close reintegrated the swept Weekly level before the end of the same qualified target week
response.false_semantic: NO QUALIFYING STRICT REINTEGRATION OBSERVED AMONG ELIGIBLE QUALIFYING H1 CLOSES BEFORE TARGET-WEEK END

binding_event_semantics.high_take: first qualifying H1 close strictly > level_price_mid

binding_event_semantics.low_take: first qualifying H1 close strictly < level_price_mid
binding_event_semantics.low_reintegration: first strictly later qualifying H1 close strictly > level_price_mid

observation_window.start: first qualifying H1 strictly after take
observation_window.end: end of the same qualified target week
observation_window.target_week_boundary_source: BEPD-02 qualified complete-week construction; Sunday 18:00 America/New_York boundary semantics from bound run manifest
